title: A Quibi co-founder and the former boss of Sora are launching an AI video startup.
summary: According to The Information , former DreamWorks co-founder (and co-founder of the quick bites video app ) Jeffrey Katzenberg’s latest move is joining up with Bill Peebles, who left OpenAI after it pivoted away from the Sora team he was leading.
